Budget.description:
Explicit work, memory and output limits of a run request.

A replicate that reaches a per-replicate limit ends with the matching termination and diagnostic; the other replicates continue.

max_events_per_replicate.description: Events one replicate may execute; reaching it ends the replicate with `event_limit` (`CRN-R040`).

max_instances.description: Distinct instances alive at once, over all types; positive. Exceeding it ends the replicate with `instance_limit` (`CRN-R042`). On `tree`, so does a count above 2^53; the static methods fail the replicate with `CRN-R030` instead.

max_output_bytes.description: Size limit of the result as compact JSON plus a trailing newline, capped at 1 GiB. Must hold at least 160 bytes per replicate (`CRN-R020`). A larger result drops statistics, paths, observations and final instances and ends as `output_limit` (`CRN-R045`); if the records alone still do not fit, the run fails with `CRN-R045`.

max_sampling_steps_per_replicate.description: Random 64-bit words one replicate may draw, counting every word, including product draws; exhausting it ends the replicate with `sampling_limit` (`CRN-R041`). The leap methods also count their iterations against it, and `hybrid` its integration steps.

threads.description: Worker threads, 1 to 64. Completed results do not depend on it.

wall_time_s.description: Wall-clock limit for the whole run in seconds, positive and finite when present. Reaching it ends running replicates with `wall_time_limit` (`CRN-R043`) and starts no others.

Ensemble.description: Independent replicates of a stochastic run.

replicates.description: Number of independent replicates, ≥ 1, with ids 0 to replicates − 1.

root_seed.description: Root seed. Each replicate draws from its own stream, derived from this seed and the replicate id, so results do not depend on the thread count.

LogSpec.description: The event log in a run request's `event_log` (rules-run/0.2 and later).

max_entries.description: Entries kept per replicate; later matching events are only counted. Replicates times `max_entries` times a per-entry bound from the model's sizes (observables, attributes and the largest reactant plus product count of a rule) must fit `budget.max_output_bytes`; the `CRN-R020` message names the bytes needed.

rules.description: An empty list logs all rules. Leaps match any listed firing. Unknown rule names are `CRN-R020` at `/event_log`.

Method.description:
The simulation method of a run request, tagged by `kind`.

Absent means `tree`. Each method reports its own sampler identity in the result's `sampler`; the same seed gives different trajectories under different samplers. Every method except `tree` needs a model that lowers to fixed instance tuples (`CRN-R020` at `/method` otherwise).

oneOf.description: Exact direct method over dynamic instances: rules are selected by their propensities, then instances from sum trees. Supports random product attributes and `new_id()`. Sampler `chacha8-u53/rules-direct/2`.

Exact direct method over the lowered network of fixed instance tuples and channels. Every positive channel must be at least 2^-53 of the total (`CRN-R031`). Sampler `chacha8-u53/rules-static-direct/1`. Ziggurat waits change the prefix to `chacha8-u53-ziggurat`, and effective sparse trackers change the suffix to `rules-static-direct-sparse-trackers/1`. From rules-run/0.6 both are the default: `waiting_time: "inverse"` with `sparse_trackers: false` runs the default of rules-run/0.5.

selector.description: `crn-craft.run/1.0` only (`CRN-R020` at `/schema` in a `rules-run` request, which always runs the linear scan). How the next channel is selected: `linear`, `composition_rejection`, `sorting`, `rssa_cr`, or `auto`, the default, which picks composition–rejection from 512 lowered channels on and the linear scan below (measured thresholds; `auto` does not pick sorting or RSSA-CR). The sampler identity names the selector that ran: `rules-static-direct` for `linear`, `rules-static-direct-cr`, `-sorting` or `-rssa-cr` for the others, followed by `-sparse-trackers` where that applies. Generated event loops and rates kernels run `linear` only (`CRN-R020` at `/method/selector`). `null` is rejected.

sparse_trackers.description: rules-run/0.4 and later. `true` integrates unweighted single-class count trackers without first-passage predicates over their constant spans, which can change the last bits of an integral. Without such a tracker it changes nothing and warns with `CRN-R051`. `false` integrates every tracker at every event. Absent means `false` before rules-run/0.6; from 0.6 it integrates the eligible trackers sparsely and, without one, runs the per-event path without a warning. `null` is rejected.

waiting_time.description: rules-run/0.4 and later. Absent selects inverse waits before rules-run/0.6 and Ziggurat waits from 0.6. `null` is rejected.

oneOf.description: rules-run/0.3 and later. Exact grouped direct method for the fixed three-class mtDNA vacancy model, sampler `chacha8-u53-ziggurat/rules-mtdna-direct/1`. A model or parameter set it cannot certify runs Static Direct instead, with that sampler identity and a `CRN-R051` warning naming the reason.
Exact next reaction method with indexed clocks over the lowered channels. Sampler `chacha8-u53/rules-next-reaction/1`.
Exact thinning with the analytic ATP flow of a rules-model/0.2 model; required for ATP models and refused for others. Sampler `chacha8-u53/rules-atp-thinning/1`.
Approximate adaptive Poisson leaps with exact fallback steps. Sampler `chacha8-u53/rules-approximate-cgp-poisson/2`.

epsilon.description: Leap tolerance, in (0, 0.1] (`CRN-R020` otherwise): the step selection bounds the mean and spread of each species and rate change in one leap by this fraction of its current value.

oneOf.description: Approximate death-then-birth splitting on the fixed lattice `k * step`, for single-parent unit births and deaths only. Sampler `chacha8-u53/rules-approximate-binomial-split/2`.

step.description: Lattice step in simulated time, finite and positive (`CRN-R020` otherwise).

oneOf.description: rules-run/0.5 and later. Piecewise-deterministic simulation of a closed model with continuous variables (rules-model/0.3): between events the variables and the integrated total propensity follow an adaptive Dormand–Prince 5(4) integration, and the next event happens where the integrated propensity reaches a unit exponential threshold, located on the dense output. Approximate at the given tolerances; sampler `chacha8-u53/rules-approximate-hybrid-dopri54/1`. Also runs models without continuous variables. Refuses ATP models (use `thinning`) and models that do not lower to fixed tuples.

atol.description: Absolute tolerance of the error control, in (0, 1e-2] (`CRN-R020` otherwise). It applies to every variable and to the integrated propensity, which runs from 0 to a unit exponential.

rtol.description: Relative tolerance of the error control, in [1e-12, 1e-2] (`CRN-R020` otherwise).

ModelRef.description: Reference from a request to its model file: a relative path and the SHA-256 of the exact model bytes.

path.description: Portable, relative to the run file's directory; no parent traversal.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact model input bytes, lowercase hexadecimal.

Outputs.description: What a result keeps besides the per-replicate records.

keep_instances.description: Final instances of replicates 0..keep_instances, at most `replicates`.

keep_paths.description: Observable series of replicates 0..keep_paths, at most `replicates`.

quantiles.description: `crn-craft.run/1.0` only (earlier versions refuse the field with `CRN-R020` at `/schema`): probabilities of quantile statistics, at most 16, strictly increasing, each in (0, 1); absent or empty means none. The result's `statistics.quantiles` then holds, for every report time and observable, the linear-interpolation quantile of the values of all replicates, NumPy's default (Hyndman and Fan type 7): with the n values sorted ascending, `h = (n - 1) * p`, `j = floor(h)` and `g = h - j`, the quantile is `x[j] + g * (x[j+1] - x[j])`, evaluated as `numpy.quantile(x, p)` evaluates it (`x[j+1] - (1 - g) * (x[j+1] - x[j])` for `g >= 0.5`, `x[n-1]` for `h >= n - 1`, NaN if a value is NaN), so the values equal NumPy's bit for bit. Quantiles are withheld with the other statistics. They keep replicates x report times x observables values in memory during the run, counted against the 2 GiB workspace limit (`CRN-R020` at `/outputs/quantiles` above it).

statistics.description: Ensemble statistics per report time and observable, each listed at most once: `mean`, and `variance` for the sample variance and the standard error of the mean. They are withheld unless every replicate completed or stopped.

RulesWaitingTime.description: How Static Direct draws waiting times (rules-run/0.4 and later).

RunVersion.description: The version of a run request, its `schema` field.

Selector.description:
How Static Direct selects the next channel (`crn-craft.run/1.0`).

Every selector samples the exact law of the lowered network; each uses the random stream in its own way, and the sampler identity names it. Every positive channel must be at least 2^-53 of the total (`CRN-R031`).

Statistic.description: Ensemble statistic to report per species and save time.

Time.description: The simulated horizon and the report grid of a run request.

end.description: Simulated time horizon, positive and finite, in the time unit of the model's rates.

report_times.description: Strictly increasing times in [0, end] at which observables are reported (right-continuous: events at a report time are included). Between 1 and 100,000 entries.

TrackerSpec.description:
A tracker in a run request's `trackers` (rules-run/0.2 and later).

It follows one observable over each replicate, from time 0 to the replicate's stop time or horizon, and reports a tracker result per replicate. A positive value is "present": crossings of zero are counted, and every present span is an episode.

first_passage.description: Optional predicate over parameters and observables, with the syntax of a model's `stop`. The first event time at which it holds (0 if it holds initially) is reported; a NaN value does not count as a hit.

keep_episodes.description: Episodes kept in full, in time order; later episodes are only summarized. Default 0.

observable.description: Name of a model observable; an unknown name is `CRN-R020` at `/trackers`. Neither the observable nor the predicate may read the continuous `ATP` column of an ATP model.

description:
A run request: `crn-craft.run/1.0`, the unified request contract, with the fields and defaults of `crn-craft.rules-run/0.6` plus `outputs.quantiles` and the Static Direct `selector`, whose default `auto` picks a selector from the lowered network (`"selector": "linear"` runs what rules-run/0.6 runs).

It binds one model, `crn-craft.model/1.0` or any `crn-craft.rules-model` version, by hash and states the time grid, the ensemble, the outputs and an explicit budget. Unknown fields and duplicate keys are rejected. It returns `crn-craft.result/1.0`.

event_log.description: Retains selected events of each replicate in the result's `observations`. rules-run/0.2 and later. `null` is rejected.

method.description: The simulation method. rules-run/0.2 and later; absent selects `tree`. `null` is rejected.

trackers.description: Event trackers, at most 256, each summarizing one observable per replicate in the result's `observations`. rules-run/0.2 and later. Not allowed in 0.1, even when empty.
